name: Ninja Sentai Kakuranger
description: It's been a long time since the great war between the Three God Generals and the Youkais, an ancient race of monstrous spirits. Since then, imprisoned in a cave protected by the mystical Seal Door, their leader Daimaou and his Youkai army wait, planning for the day they can finally strike. That day has arrived and it is up to the Kakurangers, along with the Three God Generals, to defeat the Youkais, before Daimaou's villainy destroys Earth!

videos.title: We are Ninja
videos.overview: Two young men are tricked into releasing the seal on the Yokai and must become the Ninja Sentai Kakuranger to stop the forces they have unleashed on the world.

videos.title: A Dangerous Lady
videos.overview: After the Kakurangers are attacked, Sandayuu sends the living truck Nekomaru to help.

videos.title: American Ninja
videos.overview: Jiraiya, the fifth Kakuranger, finally appears but confuses his teammates both in his foreign mannerisms and in his strange alliance with a grumpy cabby, Yokai.

videos.title: The Youkai Policeman
videos.overview: When Seikai is arrested by the police-manipulating Azukiarai, the other Kakuraner try to rescue him, even without the help of Sasuke.

videos.title: The Uneven Strange Games
videos.overview: Saizou finds himself trapped in a deadly maze with a young boy as part of a bet between a mysterious pair of men, and must make it out alive.

videos.title: The Eyeball Prince!
videos.overview: Mokumokuren decides to take revenge on the Kakuranger by trying to make them look like criminals and seducing Tsuruhime into being his bride.

videos.title: The Huge One
videos.overview: A Yokai uses Seikai's obsession with eating to it's own advantage, making him grow huge in size to satiate his never-ending appetite.

videos.title: The Bakeneko's Shop!!
videos.overview: The Kakuranger are lured into a strange shop where they become captives of a cat Yokai who captures children to feed to other Yokai.

videos.title: Hidden Camera Live
videos.overview: Jiraiya's obession with watching television becomes a problem when he encounters a Yokai who wants to cause chaos in order to become a TV star.

videos.title: Konakijiji: A Cry-Baby Goblin
videos.overview: A Yokai desiring family steals the souls of humans to place into dolls, forcing the Kakuranger to find a way to get them back from him.

videos.title: Rags are the Best!!
videos.overview: A villian with a particularly strange motivation is introduced.

videos.title: They Came Forth!! New Beast Generals
videos.overview: The Kakuranger must save a small town where children are abducted by a Yokai and a mad scientist to summon back the Yokai they've previously defeated.

videos.title: Fight Off The Bad Luck
videos.overview: The Kakuranger support a family who becomes trapped when a Yokai's bad luck forces the father of the household down and makes the mother and son try to keep afloat.

videos.title: I'm the Young Noble!!
videos.overview: While the Kakurangers battle Keukegen, a new enemy named Young NOble Junior appears to take proper command of the Yokai forces.

videos.title: Argh!! Awesome Guys
videos.overview: Junior releases two infamous Yokai criminals and uses them and a squad of female ninja to lure the Kakuranger into an inescapabled trap.

videos.title: The Red Monkey's Oni Extermination
videos.overview: With his four teammates captured by the Shuten Douji Brothers, Sasuke must avoid them and the Flowery Kunoichi Team in order to come to their rescue.

videos.title: The Demon Sword and Underwear
videos.overview: A Yokai targest Saizou due to the actions of his ancestor, leading to NinjaBlue to rely on an amateur photographer to help him defeat her.

videos.title: Hello, Mushroom-kun
videos.overview: Jiraiya befriends a child-like Yokai who grants good luck as Junior targets it to become its latest Yokai minion.

videos.title: The Hellish Trap in Darkness!!
videos.overview: The Kakuranger investigate a series of abductions caused by a spider Yokai, unknowing they are being lured into Junior's trap.

videos.title: The Flowery Kunoichi-Gumi!!
videos.overview: Sasuke becomes trapped in an ambush by the Flowery Kunoichi Team, forced to protect a kid caught in the crossfire even at the cost of his Kakuranger powers!

videos.title: Monkey See, Monkey Does Finishing Move
videos.overview: Saizou's attempt to help out a struggling ninja school leads to him giving away the Kakuranger's secrets to a monkey Yokai who turns them against the team.

videos.title: I'll Make You Laugh
videos.overview: Seikai's attempt to help a girl developing a solar car becomes hindered by a Yokai who tries to stop the research due to needing vehicle exhaust to survive!

videos.title: Blitzkrieg!! The Strange White Bird
videos.overview: Junior begins to abduct children for a ceremony to summon a powerful Yokai leader to Earth, which the Kakuranger must try to prevent from being completed.

videos.title: Ah, It's All Over
videos.overview: The Kakuranger face off with Gashadokuro in hopes of saving the children captured for Daimaou's summoning; but the end of one battle may lead to the start of a brand new trial.

videos.title: A New Departure
videos.overview: As the Kakuranger separate to find their Shinobi Scrolls, Sasuke encouunters a strange girl who wishes to teach him an important lesson despite her short, fragile life.

videos.title: The Tsuruhime Family's Super Secret
videos.overview: In the midst of her Shinobi Scroll trial, Tsuruhime is forced to go home unless she completes her trial by Sandayuu's special set of rules.

videos.title: The End of the Mighty Shogun
videos.overview: Saizou and Seikai are approached by Daimaou's emissary, who transforms them into kappa to force them to turn against each other for a chance to be human again.

videos.title: A Super Big Figure Coming to Japan!!
videos.overview: In search of the final Shinobi Scroll, Jiraiya encounters a figure from his past who is possibly connected to one of his life's greatest tragedies.

videos.title: History's First Super Battle
videos.overview: Jiraiya fights to take down his former teacher Gali in revenge for his fahter, only to ultimately discover the machinations behind the dark incident in NinjaBlack's past.

videos.title: Reunion With a Traitorous Father
videos.overview: As the Kakuranger prepare to destroy the Seal Door to prevent Daimaou's arrival on Earth, they are suddenly confronted by the Yokai's tactician, who has a very close relation to Tsuruhime.

videos.title: Behold!! A New Shogun
videos.overview: Tsuruhime tries to figure out why her father is suddenly working with the Yokai as Junior decides to attack Sandayuu seeing him as connected with Hakumenrou in secret.

videos.title: Don't Lick Me, Face Thief
videos.overview: When a face-stealing Yokai is on the attack, Saizou must protect a girl who wants to have her face taken sho she can get one like a manga character.

videos.title: The Village of Amanojaku
videos.overview: The Kakuranger reach a village where Sasuke's cousin has unknowingly released a cruel Yokai using it's tricks to make people become deceitful to one another.

videos.title: The Bride's Sandy Hell!!
videos.overview: Saizou decides to help a boy inspired by him to become a crepe master as a female Yokai transforms all edibles into sand in a scheme to win the heart of Daimaou!

videos.title: The Three Punishment Sisters
videos.overview: Tsuruhime reteams with two of her friends in order to save their sister and a school being used by a Yokai to turn them against humanity.

videos.title: The Hooligan Ninja!!
videos.overview: When the disciple of the Three God Generals returns to Earth after a thousand years in exile, both the Kakuranger and the Yokai try to reach him first even as he's discovered by two curious children.

videos.title: Karakasa Dance Queen
videos.overview: Sasuke and Tsuruhime must come to the rescue of several children and the other Kakuranger when they become captured by a dancing Yokai hoping to use them to entertain Daimaou's birthday party.

videos.title: Mooo... A Repulsive Cow
videos.overview: Jiraiya must deal with both a cow Yokai causing havoc as well as Ninjaman's continued bungling of dealing with the Yokai menance despite his better intentions.

videos.title: It's a Special Compilation!!
videos.overview: The Announcer returns with behind-the-scenes coverage eof the Kakuranger as they take on a Yokai claiming to be invincible.

videos.title: The Heisei Fox Battle
videos.overview: Tsuruhime helps a girl rescue her brother when he becomes abducted by a fox Yokai that uses children as hostages to make money.

videos.title: The Stray Ghost
videos.overview: Seikai's attempt to teach a cowardly boy courage is hindered when a Yokai unexpectedly summons the boy's grandfather.

videos.title: The Plundered Ninja Power
videos.overview: Daimaou releases a powerful clone as part of a plan to capture Ninjaman and use him as the key to take down the Three God Generals.

videos.title: The Last Day of the Three God Generals
videos.overview: As the God Generals continue to face relentless assault from Daradara, they force the Kakuranger to track down Hakumenrou in hopes of using him to figure out the means to stop Daimaou's doppleganger.

videos.title: The Wound-Filled Great Reversal
videos.overview: As the God Generals are forced to fight a Daradara further empowered by his teammates, Sasuke must uncover the truth regarding Daimaou's ultimate weapon and how to defeat it and save his squad.

videos.title: The Hasty Santa
videos.overview: The Kakuranger accidently discover from a trainee Santa Claus a scheme by a Yokai to ruin Christmas by way of mind-controlling cenitpedes.

videos.title: The New Year's Manga Hell
videos.overview: The Kakuranger become trapped in a Yokai created manga which may cause their doom within the fictional work.

videos.title: The 100-Burst Human Fireworks
videos.overview: Sasuke must save a celebrated fireworks maker when he and his granddaughter are abducted by a Yokai to create special "human fireworks" meant to celebrate Daimaou.

videos.title: The Great Snow Woman's Snowball Fight
videos.overview: Jiraiya decides to save the overworking officer and father of two children after he's abducted by a Yokai in a plan to create the ultimate blizzard.

videos.title: Suddenly!! Poor
videos.overview: The Kakuranger assist a failed businessman reunite with his family after five years of seperation and deal with a Yokai that causes individuals to become poor.

videos.title: Special Selection!! The Youkai Inn
videos.overview: Lost while looking for several missing children, the Kakuranger stay at a mysterious inn that is controlled by Daimaou's estranged siblings.

videos.title: Hero Elimination
videos.overview: Daimaou releases the soulless Hakumenrou in the ultimate plan of destroying the Kakuranger and humanity, forcing Tsuruhime to make a hard choice that may affect her own destiny.

videos.title: Finale!! Father and Daughter
videos.overview: As Tsuruhime continues to contemplate whether to kill her own father, the Kakuranger must continue to face the relentless assault of Yama-uba and the powers that continue to allow for the Yokai to assault the Earth.

videos.title: Sealing!!
videos.overview: The time for the final confrontation with Daimaou has come at last. But will it be that simple to deal with such a fiend?
